summary.zh: 六种探索规格差14.7650—16.0536；剔除稀疏单元改变目标样本，不能视作因果稳健性。
summary.en: Six exploratory specifications yield gaps of 14.7650–16.0536; sparse-cell exclusions change the target sample, not causal validity.
